t: Ready-to-use 5E lessons on Internet of Things sensors in agriculture.
steps: Open the IoT4Ag lessons page from the center at Penn and find the Ag Technology topic.
Download the intro document from the Google Drive link.
Read the lesson you want to teach first, such as water use.
Look for the parts list and ask the vendor if it is missing.
Order parts and test the sensor probe before class.
Check the Cutebot lessons for updates. They were noted as updating soon.
Teach one lesson with a small group before the full class.
